title: Connection-pool saturation characterization
summary: Sweep DB2_POOL_SIZE in {1,5,10,20} at fixed load; measure queue wait, ConnectionPoolExhausted rate, and throughput ceiling; land a concrete pool-sizing recommendation in the README.
description:
The capability inventory's E1 row calls `ConnectionPool` "the primary scalability ceiling" — this story puts a number on it. Sweep `DB2_POOL_SIZE` in {1, 5, 10, 20} at fixed offered load, measuring queue wait time, `ConnectionPoolExhausted` rate, and the throughput ceiling at each pool size. Confirm exhaustion behavior is graceful — the pool must raise `ConnectionPoolExhausted`, never hang or corrupt state, under sustained over-saturation.

Acceptance: a throughput-vs-pool-size curve exists; the saturation point is documented as a concrete number, not a qualitative impression; exhaustion is demonstrated to be graceful under load, not just assumed from reading the code; a concrete pool-sizing guideline (e.g. "pool size N supports M concurrent ops/s before queue wait exceeds X ms") lands in the SDK's README, not just in BENCHMARKS.md. Depends on BM-12.
